APPDEV RULES — CURRENT EXPERIMENTAL BASELINE

• Implement/integrate before recreating.
• Preserve independent packages and stable contracts.
• Reuse adequate installed/native/external capability.
• LINK → TAB/WebApp → EMBED → NATIVE.
• Build once around authoritative services; adapters translate.
• One obvious Install action uses RECOMMENDED profile.
• Also support LEAN / FULL / CUSTOM.
• Build → Test → Preview → Package → Deploy.
• Detect → Stage → Validate → Resolve → Install/Update/Repair → Verify → Register → Launch.
• Never automatically destroy originals.
• User data outlives software.
• Local first where practical.
• Recovery is a product feature.
• Simple outside; rigorous inside.
• Detail on demand.
• Resources are a design budget.
• Verify before destructive action.
• Generated ≠ Saved ≠ Verified ≠ Consolidated ≠ Delivered.
• UNKNOWN is never PASS.
• Private/Experimental releases require EN/SK.
